structure.summary: any structure a kit builds (light, device, frame, wall, tank, rocket part) by prefab, at a point with a turn; several placements are one job

placements.description: Up to 64 {prefab, at, rotation, facing, up, face, orient, above_floor, build_state, label, color}, built in order in one job; or one at the top level.

at.description: A point, "looking_at", or a relative or look-face form (help positions).

spread.description: {from, to, step} or a list: this prefab every step metres along each line; reports first.

up.x-script: up (+x | -x | +y | -y | +z | -z, default +y (+z when facing is vertical)): Where the top points.

face.description: Face-placed pieces (walls): the cell face it sits on.

orient.description: {mount, upright, controls_toward, ports, flow}: choose the turn by intent.

above_floor.description: Bottom this many metres above the floor below at.

build_state.description: finished (default), first, or a state index.

label.description: A name, as the Labeller writes it.

allow.description: door_keepout: a keep-out cell is a warning; lint: lint problems are warnings (listed in lint_passed); pad: building in a landing pad's approach.

verbose.description: Dry run: layouts a refused report leaves out; real run: the whole preflight.
